items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley ruled out early with hamstring vs Rams; Tank Bigsby primary early beneficiary before his own undisclosed exit.
items.why: Pulled hamstring first quarter, ruled out.
items.implication: Monitor for London Week 5; IR possible if multi-week. Backfield chaos.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps to Bigsby/Shipley; reverse if Barkley unexpectedly returns.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson scheduled for MRI on ankle after leaving Sunday's game and stadium in walking boot; Rapoport notes initial thought day-to-day.
items.why: Left game, boot post-game; tests Monday.
items.implication: Hold; Ravens offense changes significantly if he sits Week 5. Monitor practice.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase suffered concussion vs Jaguars and was ruled out; Tee Higgins also injured (adductor).
items.implication: Protocol typically multi-day; Higgins volume spike if Chase misses.

items.text: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton suffered dislocated ankle (reduced), carted, out indefinitely after career day (111 yds 2 TDs); full eval + second opinion.
items.why: Gruesome lower leg/ankle in best career game.
items.implication: Season-threatening; Chiefs WR room thinned (with Rice). Interest in Tyreek Hill noted.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (not injury); coaches managing workload/freshness in crucial spots, limiting him (e.g. 11 second-half plays).
items.why: Love: maintenance/management, long year, body tired; honest with coaches on feeling.
items.implication: Snap share capped; frustration but accepts for team success. Handcuff/backup value rises.
items.opportunity: Reduced goal-line/ dual usage; others get late-game.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful with hamstring tweak; will use bye to recover per reports.
items.why: Injured first quarter, did not return; Reid called tweak.
items.implication: Bye helps; short-term dock but monitor Week 6.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: RT Lane Johnson (personal Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion) + now Barkley.
items.implication: Offense gutted; Hurts/ remaining WRs (Wicks?) elevated but lower ceiling overall.
items.opportunity: Dontayvion Wicks/others targets if Smith out.

items.text: Bigger dock on Ladd McConkey (foot/ribs) pregame; later foot aggravation noted in ETR watch list after playing.
items.why: LP-DNP-LP practice; bigger dock; post-game foot aggravation.

items.text: ETR/Levitan small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin) return; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. He played near-full snaps/routes/targets (9-125 + rush TD).
items.why: Schefter: no intention to limit; full participant, looked sharp.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage ROS with strong schedule; buy if worried.

items.text: Terry McLaurin not expected to play (ETR weekend summary); inactive context from Schefter/Rapoport.
items.why: ETR not expected; corroborating inactive reports.
items.implication: Commanders WR targets to others (Diggs etc).

items.text: Matthew Berry: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams — boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role uncertainty who starts and crushes.
items.why: Mid-round sleeper now producing as starter.
items.implication: ROS start/upgrade; hold or buy low if available.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore aggravated shoulder; not considered long-term issue currently.
items.why: Left game; source says not long-term as of now.
items.implication: Monitor but likely short absence risk low.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) expected to play with tinier dock; no hard pitch count per reports.
items.why: ETR expected; Fowler no hard limit.
items.implication: Near-full usage; minor projection dock only.

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/optimistic but bigger dock (ribs) in ETR/Levitan projections.
items.why: Ribs; optimistic but docked more than Nacua/Flowers.
